verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own features page describes a built-in assistant, Zia, that users can ask in plain English. It also says the product's AI handles tasks such as sending bulk collection reminders, categorizing bank statements and building workflow Blueprints, which amounts to in-product delegation. The MCP material covers external agents connecting to Books, not a built-in assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of which tasks Zia can actually execute on request (versus answering questions), the scope and limits of its actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Whether it's sending bulk collection reminders, categorizing bank statements, or building workflow Blueprints, AI in Zoho Books turns financial data into the next step automatically
